title: The void has eyes
blurb: A black cat as a study in absence. Three mathematical lenses—negative space, light absorption, and the boundary of a silhouette—turn the void into something visible. Adjust the darkness and watch the cat blink.

title: The Moat
blurb: The sihek, or Guam kingfisher, is Extinct in the Wild. Plotting every kingfisher ND2 sequence in GenBank by its distance from this one bird reveals a ring 2.02 percentage points wide containing nothing at all. The chart inks the emptiness and leaves the data as dust.

title: Neuromancer, Twice
blurb: Gibson's novel coded line by line against two incompatible theories of the sign. Peirce's triadic instrument asks what kind of sign has to arrive before a reader grants a machine a mind, and finds that fluency is the wrong kind. Saussure's dyadic one asks what system of differences makes a conscious machine sayable at all. Two studies, two repositories, one novel.
